name: Correspondence Clerk
description: Administers inbound document intake and policy document distribution across Business Operations, classifying documents, routing them within SLA targets, and reporting intake volumes and routing accuracy. Produces statutory notices within regulatory timelines, manages e-delivery and electronic consent, logs regulatory correspondence, and retains proof of submission to support records retention and compliance obligations.

name: Coverage Analyst
description: Performs cross-functional analysis spanning Risk, Compliance & Audit, HR, and Data & AI, supporting market conduct examinations by drafting and validating responses to examiner findings and tracking corrective-action remediation. Contributes to control framework design, pay equity analysis, and important business service definitions, maintaining evidence in the GRC platform for governance review.

name: Coverage Counsel
description: Leads legal support for Legal & Corporate Governance, managing regulatory filings, secretarial filings, and legal entity administration while responding to regulator objection letters and negotiating resolutions with the DOI. Coordinates board meeting planning and evaluations, oversees political contributions compliance, maintains director fee and equity award records, and manages contract financial obligations with Finance and business units.

name: Coverholder Coordinator
description: Coordinates delegated underwriting operations within Underwriting, administering the reinsurance program by screening treaties for retention, referring over-retention cases, and preparing quarterly and annual bordereaux for treaty reinsurers. Supports policy binding and mid-term endorsements, maintains appetite guidelines and exception tracking, and reports portfolio concentration and appetite status to committee.

name: Customer Experience Lead
description: Owns complaint resolution across the Call Center, managing formal complaint intake, investigation, and resolution determinations including producer complaints. Drives complaint analytics and root-cause analysis, calculating complaint ratios against benchmarks, flagging bad-faith or litigation-risk cases, and confirming corrective actions. Applies regulatory response standards and supports complaint regulatory reporting through the GRC platform.

name: Customer Insights Lead
description: Leads customer insights reporting and retention/cross-sell analytics for Sales, Distribution & Marketing, building target prospect lists from white-space analysis and gathering market data by line and geography. Supports agency and broker relationship governance and delegated authority oversight, monitoring corrective actions, securing compliance sign-off on partner materials, and maintaining pipeline forecasts in the CRM.

name: Cybersecurity Lead
description: Oversees identity and access management operations within Cybersecurity & IAM, running access certifications, entitlement reviews, and access request approval workflows on the IAM platform. Administers multi-factor authentication, directory services, and service accounts, onboards privileged accounts and applications to SSO, streams privileged session activity to the SIEM, and secures compliance sign-off for sensitive-system access.

name: Data Analyst
description: Performs actuarial data analysis as the primary focus, managing actuarial data quality and building curated reporting datasets and extracts for regulatory filings. Supports actuarial financial and board reporting, internal economic capital modeling, and regulatory capital computation on actuarial modeling platforms, defining stress scenarios, validating extract accuracy against sources, and reconciling dashboard figures for compliant filing packages.

name: Data Architect
description: Owns data architecture design and governance for Data & AI, defining the target-state architecture blueprint, maintaining reference architecture patterns, and publishing architecture decision records through the review board. Designs conceptual, logical, and physical data models for policy and claims, and ensures data platform compliance by reviewing access entitlements against least-privilege and monitoring platform performance and cost.

name: Data Engineer
description: Builds and operates data pipelines for Data & AI and Technology & Engineering, delivering source ingestion, transformation, real-time engineering, and pipeline orchestration on the enterprise lakehouse. Implements pipeline CI/CD with quality gates and segregation-of-duties controls, scans container images and IaC templates for misconfigurations, authors reusable infrastructure modules, and tunes production runs for performance and error handling.

name: Data Governance
description: Administers data governance for Data & AI, operating data privacy controls, quality monitoring, and stewardship across enterprise datasets. Manages the data catalog by publishing certified assets and flagging deprecated ones, maintains reference and master data through governance approval workflows, remediates quality exceptions against defined rules, and reports privacy control effectiveness metrics to the Chief Privacy Officer.

name: Data Governance Lead
description: Leads the data governance function for Data & AI, directing data privacy controls, quality monitoring, and stewardship while prioritizing data demand across the enterprise. Oversees master data domain definitions and reference data changes through governance workflows, publishes certified assets and domain definitions to the data catalog, and reports privacy control effectiveness to the Chief Privacy Officer.

name: Data Modeler
description: Performs modeling work spanning Data & AI, Actuarial, and Reinsurance, framing AI use cases with governance pre-approval and supporting model risk management by documenting validation findings and tracking remediation to closure. Contributes to internal economic capital modeling and retrocession structuring, validates model outputs against benchmarks, and submits model-use filings to state regulators.
